scripts.build-extension: bun ./bin/generate-packages.ts && bunx web-ext build --source-dir ext/build-ch --artifacts-dir ext --filename feedfathom_ch.zip --overwrite-dest && bunx web-ext build --source-dir ext/build-ff --artifacts-dir ext --filename feedfathom_ff.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.build-server: bun run build-spa && bun build src/server.ts --outfile build/index.js --target bun
scripts.build-project: rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && bun run build-server && bun run build-migrator && bun run build-worker && bun run build-extension && bun run build-cloudflare-email-worker
scripts.test:browser: bun run build-extension && playwright test --config tests/browser/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:smoke: bun -e 'if (!process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL) throw new Error("PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL is required")' && playwright test --config tests/browser/playwright.config.ts tests/browser/production-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.quality: bun run test:unit && bun run test:browser && bun run lint && bun run build-project
scripts.lint: bun run format && bun run oxlint && bun run knip
scripts.lint:fix: bun run format:fix && bun run oxlint:fix
scripts.generate-migrations: drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle/config.json && bun run format:fix
